question.html:
A child launches a toy car of mass m by compressing and releasing a spring of spring constant k. The car travels along a track from point A to point F. The initial momentum of the toy car right after it loses contact with the spring is p. Assume that friction within the spring and air friction are negligible and that the surface between point A and point B is frictionless.

a. Show that the distance by which the spring has been compressed can be expressed as . 

  [2]

b.  A certain spring is 12.4 cm long and has a spring constant of 63.9 N m. A toy car with a mass of 120 g is launched by compressing this spring to a length of 7.2 cm. Show that the initial speed of the toy car is 1.2 m s.

   [3]

c. After the toy car has been launched, it travels along the track from point A to point F, where it comes to rest for a moment. The surface between point B and point F is not frictionless. The distance between point B and point C is 3.5 cm and the speed of the toy car at point C is 1.15 m s. Calculate the coefficient of dynamic friction of the surface between point B and point C.

  [3]

d. The toy car loses 15% of its kinetic energy due to friction between point B and point F. The height of the ramp between point C and point D is 1.2 cm. The shape of the track between point E and point F is a circular arc with centre O. Angle  is 90. Find the length of the track between E and F. 

  [4]
